insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 4 G3+ games, 13/20 picks (65%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 38 champs in G1s, 18 in G3+.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Bard is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Bard in 15/27 games (56%): 1 pick (0-1) and 14 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Jarvan IV? They go Xin Zhao
insights.text: Jarvan IV is a G1 favorite (4/12 G1s, played by eXyu). In the 10 later games where it was burned or banned, eXyu went to Xin Zhao (5/10) and Vi (2/10).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned
